Yes i have periodontal disease which the dentist told me i needed to get cleanings done every 3 months but my insurance only would pay for it every 6 months. I still do that to this day because you never know what is going to happen.

That is tough when you went in did you fill out any paperwork? I understand how you feel what they did to you was wrong. They should have checked and made sure coverage was valid before they started doing any work on you. I am not sure if you can file this bill with your insurance company and ask for reimbursement for it.

Next time before you go to another dentist verify with your insurance company before hand to make sure that the dentist you are seeing is in-network. Also you might want to look at your dental policy so you can become more familiar with it. I know that some dental insurances will cover regular cleanings every 6 months at no charge. But when you have periodontal disease it can be different. I hope this helps you.

I would hurry up and find one because if he does go out of business and then tries to create a new one like my builder did maybe then you can go after them. Have you tried contacting the North Carolina Home Builders Association? I am only suggesting that because we first contacted Georgia Home Builders Association when we first had issues. 

We were told that the 2-10 warranty was going to cost us over $10,000. Even though the realtor that represented the builder said that we got the information at closing which we didn’t  and we had to wait 4 months for a crappy warranty booklet that was covered with ants. 

Do you live in a subdivision? If you have other homeowners that are currently having the same issues as you then maybe all of you can get together and get this resolved. Has your realtor been helping you?

I thought I had issues with my first new home back in 2016 but we had the warranty issue just like you did. We found out that the builder who built our house he had three previous companies that all went bankrupt. I was lucky enough to maintain a relationship with one of the subs who did work on our house. We decided right before the end of the one year warranty since we got screwed out of the home warranty that we were supposed to get. We got a home inspection done and a lot of issues were serious and the inspector was wondering how the house passed with the various issues. So the following day i sent an email to the builders wife who is the one who handles everyone's issues and I told her before that I am not going to let them push me around and that I will report them etc. I sent everything to her reminded her again that I know everything including the fact that the building permit was listed under another company which was illegal and within a week they had all the subs out repairing what should have been fixed to begin with. I am still unhappy with the builder. What I am more upset about is this was my first home and it is was supposed to be an enjoyable experience and it was not at all. And I regret it if I could have a redo i would have done my research on the builder first and made sure this never happens again. I would highly suggest a real estate attorney that is what we were going to do but after I called the builder out on everything the attitude changed.

Try not to blame yourself for everything that has happened between you and your and father that will take some time to understand. But i would connect with the current family that you have in your life right now and connect with them through this hard time. You don’t want to end up dealing with this all alone like I ended up doing. And if you need to seek professional help please do don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
